overview: Build a small sci‑fi side‑mounted cannon/turret: a chunky base block on the left with a forward armature leading to a twin‑barrel/energy‑coil module on the right, matching the reference silhouette.

subassemblies.name: Base / Body Block
subassemblies.description: Large rectangular platform with a studded top, forming the main mass. Build as a 2–3 brick‑tall box using plates/bricks in Light/Dark Bluish Gray; keep the top mostly studs for mounting.
subassemblies.image_location: Left side (the big light/dark gray rectangular block with many studs on top)

subassemblies.name: Side Mount / Shoulder Extension
subassemblies.description: A smaller rectangular protrusion that connects the base to the cannon. Use a short stack of plates/bricks to step out from the base and provide a sturdy attachment point.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-left (small gray block sticking out from the big base)

subassemblies.name: Cannon Core / Greeble Linkage
subassemblies.description: A thin ‘spine’ between the shoulder extension and barrels, made from small round plates/tiles to suggest joints/couplers. Keep it straight and low-profile.
subassemblies.image_location: Center (the small gray round elements between the extension and the black cylinders)

subassemblies.name: Twin Barrels / Energy Coils
subassemblies.description: Two short black cylindrical stacks (each a 1x1 round brick/cylinder with a round top) mounted in line to read as twin barrels or coil housings.

subassemblies.name: Muzzle / Front Housing
subassemblies.description: Compact front unit using a small black bracket/modified brick with a circular detail (or a 1x1 with stud/round plate) to read as the cannon’s muzzle/receiver. Attach directly ahead of the barrels.
subassemblies.image_location: Far right (the black piece with a round detail on its face)

subassemblies.name: Optional Stand / Stabilizer (recommended)
subassemblies.description: A simple underside foot or small skid under the cannon module to keep the model stable and ‘intentional’ when displayed; use a couple of plates/tiles in dark gray/black.
subassemblies.image_location: Under the center-right area (not prominent in the reference, but supports the long overhang)

notes: Color-match the reference with Light/Dark Bluish Gray for the base and Black for the barrel module; use small round Light Bluish Gray elements as couplers.
Keep connections simple: base block built as a sturdy box; extension attaches with overlapping plates; barrels attach via studs on top or a small bracket/modified plate.
If you have spare 1x2/1x4 plates, widen the base slightly to counterbalance the right-side overhang.
You can add 2–6 small greebles (cheese slopes/tiles/rounds) on the base top to make it feel more ‘mechanical’ while staying buildable.
